title: Open derived sections respect the canonical truncation tower
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, $V$ an arbitrary open, $E\in D(\mathcal O_X)$, and let $r_V$ be exact restriction. Let $G$ be evaluation on V followed by forgetting module scalars to abelian groups and $H$ abelian global sections on the scheme V. There exist isomorphisms $e:RH(r_VE)\cong RG(E)$ and $e_n:RH(\tau_{\geq -n}r_VE)\cong RG(\tau_{\geq -n}E)$ for every natural n, such that $RH(\pi_n)e_n=eRG(\pi_n)$ and $RH(f_n)e_n=e_{n+1}RG(f_n)$, where $\pi_n$ are the canonical truncation projections and $f_n:\tau_{\geq -(n+1)}\to\tau_{\geq -n}$ the canonical transitions. There is no acyclicity hypothesis and no assertion of reconstruction.

proof.text: Restriction preserves K-injectives by its exact extension-by-zero left adjoint, and the equivalence to modules on the open scheme also preserves them. The underived identity of abelian sections on V and global sections after restriction is natural. Derive it using the composition comparison for K-injective-preserving functors and identify exact derived restriction with its mapDerivedCategory. This produces a natural isomorphism RH after r_V with RG.

Use the existing Functor.mapDerivedCategoryTruncGEIso for exact restriction, rather than constructing a second truncation isomorphism. Its inverse is the factorization descTruncGE, and π_descTruncGE gives projection compatibility. The two induced transition maps coincide by from_truncGE_obj_ext after precomposition with the truncation projection and π_natTransTruncGEOfLE_app. Applying RH and composing with the natural comparison of the first step yields e_n and the two displayed squares.

theorem openDerivedSections_truncationTower_comparison
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (V : X.Opens)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wC} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wV} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings V.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wA} AddCommGrpCat.{u}]
    (E : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))) :
    let S := SheafOfModules.evaluation.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) (op V)
    letI : S.Additive := inferInstanceAs
      ((SheafOfModules.forget.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) ⋙
        PresheafOfModules.evaluation.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).obj (op V)).Additive)
    let G := S ⋙ forget₂
      (ModuleCat.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).obj.obj (op V))) AddCommGrpCat.{u}
    let H := RingedSpace.openModuleSections V.toScheme.toRingedSpace ⊤
    let R := (schemeOpenRestriction X V).mapDerivedCategory
    let t := DerivedCategory.TStructure.t
      (C := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
    let s := DerivedCategory.TStructure.t
      (C := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings V.toScheme.toRingedSpace))
    ∃ (e : H.rightDerivedFunctor.obj (R.obj E) ≅ G.rightDerivedFunctor.obj E)
      (en : ∀ n : ℕ, H.rightDerivedFunctor.obj ((s.truncGE (-(n : ℤ))).obj (R.obj E)) ≅
        G.rightDerivedFunctor.obj ((t.truncGE (-(n : ℤ))).obj E)),
      (∀ n : ℕ, H.rightDerivedFunctor.map ((s.truncGEπ (-(n : ℤ))).app (R.obj E)) ≫
        (en n).hom = e.hom ≫ G.rightDerivedFunctor.map ((t.truncGEπ (-(n : ℤ))).app E)) ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, H.rightDerivedFunctor.map
        ((s.natTransTruncGEOfLE (-((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) (-(n : ℤ)) (by omega)).app (R.obj E)) ≫
          (en n).hom = (en (n + 1)).hom ≫ G.rightDerivedFunctor.map
            ((t.natTransTruncGEOfLE (-((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) (-(n : ℤ)) (by omega)).app E))
